f.title: Apply for the BPFV Implementation Certificate with the signed application form under sworn declaration
f.statement: To obtain the Certificate of Implementation of Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (BPFV), the marketing authorisation holder must submit to DINAVISA, under sworn declaration, the certificate application form available on the DINAVISA website, signed by the Regent/Technical Director and the Legal Representative of the holder (the checklist and supporting documentation that must accompany it are in the next row).

f.statement: If the evaluation of the documentation is unsatisfactory, the Directorate of Health Technology Surveillance informs the holder, who must remedy the observations within 30 business days from notification.

f.title: Submit a corrective action plan within 30 business days after inspection findings
f.statement: If the inspection (remote interactive evaluation or on site) finds non-compliance, the holder is notified and must submit a corrective action plan within no more than 30 business days from notification.
f.clause: Artículo 6°
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Quality system & CAPA

f.title: Renew the BPFV certificate by applying up to 60 days before expiry
f.statement: The BPFV Implementation Certificate is valid for 36 months from issue. It may be renewed by the holder, who must apply for a new Certificate, meeting the requirements of this Resolution, up to 60 days before expiry.
f.clause: Artículo 7°
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Quality system & CAPA

f.title: Holder and Technical Director are responsible for the integrity and authenticity of submitted information
f.statement: The holder and the Regent/Technical Director are responsible for the integrity and authenticity of the information, documentation and declarations provided; if alteration, falsity or illegitimacy is proven, they are liable to civil, criminal and administrative consequences under Art. 243 of the Paraguayan Criminal Code.
f.clause: Artículo 12°
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA
